title: What can a retina teach us?

title: Show the judge a neighbour.
description: A small probe flags a sentence. An LLM judge dismisses it. One labelled example changes the verdict. What can that reversal teach us about explanations?
image_alt: A nearby labelled training example helps an LLM judge reconsider a probe's prediction.
